lines.en: I bounce forward, hop by hop.
On landing I spread into a puddle.
I gather up and bounce again.
Water sloshes inside me.
I hop over a stone.
Wet round marks are left on the grass.
I hop in your direction.
Each bounce comes lower than the last.
I shift over slowly. No rush.
Grass blades pass through me.
I bounce twice on landing.

lines.zh: 水声在前面，我一跳一跳。
lines.en: Water sounds ahead; I bounce toward it.
I roll to the slope's bottom and spread out.
Then I right myself.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方草都湿了
lines.en: The grass is wet where I've been.
I slow down; my hops shorten.
I spread on the ground and slowly wobble.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳，落地就摊开。
lines.en: Each hop of mine spreads flat on landing.
I swell once, then settle.

lines.zh: 我看不见，但我感觉得到
lines.en: I can't see, but I can feel.
Grass stands up through my body.
An insect crawls onto me.
I stay still and it moves off.
The sun warms me.
I shift a little into the shade.
My color pales in the light.
I stay quiet.
Wind passes; I quiver.

lines.zh: 你的影子罩下来，我看不见光。
lines.en: Your shadow falls, and I lose the light.
I bounce toward you once.
You're so tall; I'd have to look up.
I'm in no hurry to come closer.

lines.zh: 你的影子比我的大太多
lines.en: Your shadow is far bigger than mine.
I can feel you watching.
Step back, and I'll come nearer.
I'm soft. Hitting me wouldn't hurt.
Touch me and your hand gets wet.
I've stopped by your feet.

lines.zh: 身上缺了一角，地上湿了。
lines.en: A corner is missing, and the ground is wet.

lines.zh: 我摊成一滩，才又聚起来。
lines.en: I spread into a puddle before gathering again.
My body has grown thinner.
I hop back twice.
There's a new puddle on the ground.
I slowly gather again.
I've shrunk a little.
Something inside me aches.
I press to the ground and keep still.
One more and I'll come apart.
That thing is in front of me.

lines.zh: 我弹了一下，又停下看你。
lines.en: I bounce once, then stop and look at you.
I fold it into myself.
It floats inside me.
I wrap it twice; it's still hard.
I push it out and take it in again.

lines.zh: 蓝色胶体，还想要黏液球。
lines.en: Blue gel wants more gel.
It smells like water, but not quite.
Just put it on the ground.
I deal with it slowly.
You stepped on me; I spread out.
I gather back into shape.
I've stuck to your boot.
I slide off and land on the ground.
One bump and I lose my shape.

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚踝滑了过去。
lines.en: I slide past against your ankle.
A wet patch is left on the ground.
One push and I roll away.
I slowly roll back.
Your foot is warm.
I'm stuck to your ankle.
I shudder and bounce off.
That wet spot is my mark.
I hop after you, bounce by bounce.
You're blue too.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起会合起来
lines.en: Pressed together, we'd merge.
I shift toward you a little.
Two blues set side by side.
We can share this puddle.
I hop slowly; wait for me.
Let's hop into the shade together.

lines.zh: 你跳过的坑，我也跳过去。
lines.en: The pit you leap, I leap too.
You go first; I'll follow.
Don't hop too far.
I fold it into my body.
It turns over inside me.
Too heavy for me to shift.

lines.zh: 我用身体把它挤进缝里。
lines.en: I squeeze it into a crack with my body.
It slowly sinks in.
I don't take in hard things.
I can't hold it; this piece is too sharp.
I'll try what's on the ground first.
That came with some soil.
I draw it in bit by bit.
Something's beside me.
I bounce once and turn.
I feel the warmth.
It's three steps from me.
No hurry. Let me look first.
The grass is flattened over there.

lines.zh: 蓝色的我，一跳一跳地靠。
lines.en: Blue, I close in bounce by bounce.
My body is ready.
A little closer and I touch it.
I bounce that way.
Each hop lands closer than the last.
It retreats, so I slow down.
After landing, I gather back into a ball.
I press it toward the stones.
My body stays low to the ground.
It stepped on part of me.
I tighten up.
Only one step left.
I flatten myself, storing the spring.

lines.zh: 我弹起来，对准你的膝盖。
lines.en: I bounce up, aimed at your knee.
I flatten out and cover its feet.

lines.zh: 我的身体包住了它的脚
lines.en: My body wraps its foot.
I bounce away.
I cling, then bounce off.
Not heavy, but sticky.
It trod on me.
I gather into a blob and bounce up.
It has backed well away.
I roll slowly back into the grass.
I've gone quiet.
I take shape on the ground.
At first I'm only a small puddle.
I swell and become round.
On my first hop I splatter.
I gather up and hop again.
The light here suits me.
The grass is tall; I'm nearly hidden.
I head toward the sound of water.
The ground is soft; my hops are steady.

lines.zh: 我先摊开，再收成一个圆。
lines.en: I spread out first, then pull into a circle.
The heat takes my water away.
I hop, and contact hurts.
Too much water; I'm dissolving into it.
The blast tears my body apart.

lines.zh: 一根尖物穿过我，留个洞
lines.en: Something sharp passes through, leaving a hole.

lines.zh: 这股力量让我的身体僵住
lines.en: This force stiffens my body.
I shrink to the size of a fist.
Lightning passes through me, lighting the whole blob.
I scatter into drops and keep falling.
